name: academic-skill
description: One academic skill for Norwegian and English assignments, writing, source checks, exam practice, presentations and Office files.

interface.longDescription: Work from a brief and a rubric, draft and revise in your own voice, check sources, practise for an exam, or prepare and review academic presentations and Office files. Academic Skill selects guidance for each task in Norwegian or English. File editing and external searches depend on the tools available in your session.
defaultPrompt: Turn my assignment and rubric into a plan.
Check my claims against the excerpt I provide.
Quiz me on my notes, one question at a time.
